Chapter 6457: This Lowly One Deserves Death

Chapter 6457: This Lowly One Deserves Death

“They must yield regardless of who they are before me.” Li Qiye still sat leisurely in his chair.

“The strongest in Gold Village is Lord Alch-deer.” Dugu Qing reminded him.

“Let him come have an audience.” Li Qiye said.

“Is he insane?” The crowd clamored in astonishment.

A total of six official golden lords resided in Gold Village - Earthsplitter Ancestor from Seventy-two Skyraiser Sect, Iron-spear from Trinity, Rising Buddha from Immortal Gate, Luosha Devil Emperor, Ocean-gaze Ancestor, and Alch-deer Emperor.

Alch-deer somehow became the strongest and surpassed the primal ancestors despite having a single dao fruit.

Whether it be to luck or a special skill, he found the most gold and conjured the tallest tree. His title was Lord Alch-deer, worshipped as the highest being. No one stood a chance against him due to his abundant golden laws.

Some said due to his background, he possessed an immortal art from Desolate Ancestor. This made it possible for him to find gold so quickly.

Another rumor stated that as a spirit deer, he was attuned to nature and had an innate gift that helped him find gold. Because of this, he had the tallest golden tree and a supreme position.

Now, this brat was talking about granting him an audience in Gold Village?

“You deserve death for your disrespect.” Golden Monarch roared.

If Lord Alch-deer were to catch wind of such blasphemy happening in their town, he might destroy everything.

“Who dares disrespect Lord Alch-deer?!” Someone roared furiously and golden particles engulfed the town.

“Rumble!” A group of cavalry rushed closer like a flood of steel, crushing everything in their wake.

The leader wrote a stallion and possessed a golden tree. The three kings’ trees looked like a shrub in comparison.

He wore a loose black robe, making others wonder if he had stolen someone else’s. His sleeves and pant cuffs were tied so the outfit billowed outward, making him look muscular.

“Black Wind Monarch!” The crowd shouted.

“It’s Black Wind Monarch!” Many kneeled before him.

Although Black Wind Monarch had numerous exploits, the most important thing was his close relationship with Lord Alch-deer.

“Black Wind Monarch.” The three kings of the town bowed before him.

“Who dared bluster?” He uttered coldly, intimidating everyone with his golden energy.

He was a desolate god in the real world so his cultivation surpassed everyone present. Moreover, he had received enough assistance from Alch-deer so his gold power was even stronger than his real cultivation.

“Monarch, this ignorant brat said even Lord Alch-deer would need to yield before him, he deserves death...” Snake Monarch was horrified and snitched immediately.

Black Wind took a look at the offender.

“Shut up!” His expression changed dramatically as he slapped and sent Snake Monarch flying out of Octagon.

“Bam!” He smashed against the ground, resulting in a huge crater.

“How does it feel to be a king here?” Li Qiye asked with a smile.

Black Wind immediately jumped off his stallion and rolled on the ground until he reached Li Qiye. He prostrated and said: “Young Noble, this lowly one deserves death for the late reception.”

This naturally shocked everyone.

“What?” Dugu Qing herself couldn’t remain calm.

“Who is he?” Someone whispered.

The crowd was also smart enough to kneel while stealing glances at Li Qiye.

“No need for that, rise.” Li Qiye smiled.

“Thank you, Young Noble.” Black Wind bowed his head repeatedly before standing up.

He knew he was nothing before Li Qiye. Even Lord Alch-deer would need to kneel since the guy was a supreme ancestor of Desolate Frontier. He only needed one strike to destroy Heavenly Crane and must at least be a mythical overlord.
